techStack: Test runner: Vitest 3.2.4 with jsdom 26.1.0 environment
Vitest globals enabled (describe, it, expect, vi available without import)
tests/setup.ts auto-imported by vitest config — stubs global.fetch via vi.stubGlobal in beforeEach, restores via vi.unstubAllGlobals in afterEach
userEvent v14 API: must call userEvent.setup() before render; use returned instance for user.type(), user.click(), user.selectOptions()
No path aliases; test files import App as '../src/App'
features:
results-count element:

— text format 'Showing N products (page X of Y)'
Product cards: <article data-testid="product-{id}"> — queried via getAllByRole('article')

Error state:

— rendered instead of results-count when fetch fails
Spinner: <div aria-label="loading"> — rendered only during initial async fetch

Empty state:

— rendered by ProductList when filter yields 0 results
Setup.ts mock returns all 15 products from products.ts fixture + { totalPages: 1 }
Test stub files already have necessary imports (render, screen, userEvent where applicable, App) but empty describe blocks
Products fixture fields: id, name, category, price, inStock, rating, reviewCount, description, tags, discountPct?
architecture: State managed in useProductFilters hook: filters, products, isLoading, error, page, totalPages via useState
State flows: hook → App → FilterPanel (filters + onChange + categories), SortSelect (value + onChange), ProductList (products)
Prev/Next buttons live in App.tsx: Prev disabled when page<=1, Next disabled when page>=totalPages

Loading branch renders only; error branch renders

{error}

only; both exclude results-count
Test files live at src/benchmark-frontend/tests/ (sibling to src/), not at root tests/ or src/tests/
productFilters.ts: search is case-insensitive substring on name; category is exact match or 'All'; sortBy: default|price-asc|price-desc|rating-desc
Categories generated dynamically in App from product data: ['All', 'Electronics', 'Fitness', 'Accessories']
edgeCases: userEvent v14: const user = userEvent.setup() must be called before render(<App />) in each test that uses interactions
Async load: always await screen.findByTestId('results-count') before any filter/sort interactions

Error test override: use vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('Network error'))) in the test body before render — setup.ts beforeEach runs first but this overrides it for that test
Out-of-stock products (inStock: false): USB-C Hub, Noise-Cancelling Headphones, Dumbbell Set, Desk Lamp — 11 products in stock
Sort selectOptions must use value strings ('price-asc', 'price-desc', 'rating-desc'), not display labels
Category selectOptions must use exact strings ('Electronics', 'Fitness', 'Accessories'), not 'All' for filtering
Rating sort: only assert first two unambiguous positions (Yoga Mat 4.8, Mechanical Keyboard 4.7) to avoid flakiness from ties
Each test needs its own render(<App />) call — React Testing Library cleanup runs between tests automatically
loadingError.test.tsx: spinner check must happen synchronously after render() before any await; results-count must be absent (queryByTestId returns null) after fetch error
